_fieldGuide.settings: 全局轮换和显示设置；详见 DATA_GUIDE.md。
_fieldGuide.employees: 员工名单与固定轮换顺序；新员工加入末尾。
_fieldGuide.leavePeriods: Annual leave: assessed separately per Monday-Friday roster week. 1-4 leave weekdays retain the assignment with a Leave label and no substitution; 5 leave weekdays skip the employee for that week.
_fieldGuide.availabilityPeriods: 员工暂时不需要停车位的范围；结束日期为 null 表示持续暂停。
_fieldGuide.officeClosures: Office closure date ranges; fully closed Monday-Friday weeks pause rotation without consuming a turn.
_fieldGuide.manualOverrides: 特定日期的人工分配覆盖；谨慎使用。
_fieldGuide.weeklyAssignments: Legacy snapshots retained for compatibility; current schedule is recalculated from rotation rules, leave and closures.
_fieldGuide.changeLog: 网页内修改记录；静态版本不代表身份认证审计。
